objective: Restore and qualify one coherent standalone headless Arch Linux server; display is optional.

defaults.environment: Unprivileged development host; device rows use only the existing admitted lifecycle under one coordinator.
defaults.mutations: Offline: only test-owned temporary files/processes/loopback sockets. No phone contact, credentials, host service changes or persistent storage writes.
defaults.cleanup: Existing test temporary-directory/process cleanup; never remove shared artifacts or private evidence.
evidence: actual release artifact hashes when supplied
exit status and private log hash
device rows: candidate, boot ID, power/connection conditions and last completed stage
defaults.deadline_rule: Per-row total wall time; expiry FAIL; missing prerequisite BLOCKED; not selected NOT RUN. No test may silently skip required behavior.
defaults.release_rule: All mandatory rows PASS for one frozen source/artifact/test identity. No result imports or merging across runs yet; earlier evidence is not reused automatically.
